subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw keep configured model costs USD-only, or define a non-USD currency contract for configured local/provider model pricing and cost display?
rationale: The request adds public configuration and changes cost-accounting semantics across schema, status output, Control UI, docs, telemetry, and mixed-provider aggregation.

options.title: Design a currency contract first
options.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, and persisted-field semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep configured costs USD-only
options.body: Leave `models.providers.*.models[].cost` as USD estimates and keep non-USD balances in provider usage reporting.

options.title: Allow a display-only override
options.body: Permit a narrow symbol override while documenting that stored totals and telemetry remain USD-shaped estimates.

recommendation.title: Design a currency contract first
recommendation.body: Choose provider/model/global scope, ISO validation, mixed-currency behavior, and persisted-field semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The original usage-cost feature and current USD formatter path trace back to steipete, and the decision affects that public accounting contract.
